script.title: AT THE BOBA SHOP
script.scene_zh: 手搖飲店 · 客製點單
script.story_hook: One boba cup, but ten tiny choices to make.
script.intro_zh: 一杯珍珠奶茶，卻有十個小選擇要決定。
script.welcome_en: Hello, and welcome to the boba counter today. Listen for customizing words.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎來到今天的手搖飲櫃台。留意客製化的說法。
script.outro: That's a full boba order, start to finish. Hear it twice and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 這就是從頭到尾的一杯手搖飲。聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to echo each line with me now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在輪到跟著我逐句複誦。
script.char_a_description: a high school girl around sixteen with long straight black hair in a high ponytail, a navy blazer school uniform with a striped tie and plaid skirt, a small backpack on one shoulder, slight build
script.char_b_description: a laid-back college-age man in his early twenties with chin-length straight hair dyed icy silver, an oversized fuchsia hoodie, black earbuds hanging around his neck, and a tall lanky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, how long is the wait right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə weɪt ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，嗯，現在大概要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not long, five minutes tops. What sounds good?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt lɔŋ faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ˈtɑps wʌt ˈsaʊndz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 不久，最多五分鐘。想喝點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taro milk tea is your famous drink, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə təˈɹoʊ ˈmɪk ˈti ɪz jɔɹ ˈfeɪməs dɹɪŋk ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 芋頭牛奶是你們店的招牌，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, but honestly the winter melon is great too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bʌt ˈɑnəstli ðə ˈwɪnɚ ˈmɛlən ɪz ɡɹeɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 是招牌，不過老實說冬瓜茶也很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'll go with the taro then.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪl ɡoʊ wɪð ðə təˈɹoʊ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那我還是選芋頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic choice. What sugar level do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk tʃɔɪs wʌt ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈlɛvəl du ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 經典選法。甜度要幾分？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what's normal for most people?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌts ˈnɔɹməl fɚ moʊst ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大多數人一般都點幾分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half, but regulars usually go twenty-five or thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf bʌt ˈɹɛɡjələrz ˈjuʒəwəli ɡoʊ ˈtwɛnti faɪv ɔɹ ˈθɜɾi/
dialogue.zh: 五分糖，不過老顧客都選二分半或三分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm a beginner, let's do thirty percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ə bɪˈɡɪnɚ lɛts du ˈθɜɾi pɚˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 我才剛入門，那就三分糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. And ice: normal, less, or none?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ænd aɪs ˈnɔɹməl lɛs ɔɹ nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。冰塊呢：標準、少冰，還是去冰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less ice, please. My bag never stays dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs aɪs pliz maɪ bæɡ ˈnɛvɚ steɪz dɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 少冰就好。我的書包總是很容易濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, true. Toppings? Pearls are the house favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɹu ˈtɑpɪŋz pɝlz ɑɹ ðə haʊs ˈfeɪvɚɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真的耶。要加料嗎？珍珠是店內最受歡迎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes to pearls, um, can I get extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu pɝlz ʌm kən aɪ ɡɛt ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 要珍珠，嗯，可以再多加一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra's a dollar more, a big scoop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛkstɚz ə ˈdɑlər mɔɹ ə bɪɡ skup/
dialogue.zh: 多加一份多一塊錢，是滿滿一大匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do it, I like chewing more than drinking.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɪt aɪ laɪk ˈtʃuɪŋ mɔɹ ðæn ˈdɹɪŋkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 加吧，我喜歡嚼的勝過喝的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same energy. Any other topping on that?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈɛnɚdʒi ˈɛni ˈʌðɚ ˈtɑpɪŋ ɑn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我懂這種熱情。還要別的配料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there cheese foam on the menu?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ tʃiz foʊm ɑn ðə ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 菜單上有芝士奶蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but with taro it's super rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt wɪð təˈɹoʊ ɪts ˈsupɚ ɹɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 有，不過芋頭配奶蓋會甜膩得過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh risky. Maybe just pearls this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /u ˈɹɪski ˈmeɪbi dʒʌst pɝlz ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢，有點冒險。這次就先只加珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise. One problem though: the pearls just ran out.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz wʌn ˈpɹɑblɛm ðoʊ ðə pɝlz dʒʌst ɹæn ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 明智。不過有個問題：珍珠剛剛賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the famous pearls are gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈfeɪməs pɝlz ɑɹ ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，招牌珍珠全都沒了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New batch is ready at five, it's four fifteen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju bæts ˈɹɛdi æt faɪv ɪts fɔɹ ˈfɪftin naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 新的一鍋五點才煮好，現在四點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, that's the whole point of my order!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ðæts ðə hoʊl pɔɪnt əv maɪ ˈɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 喔不，珍珠才是我這杯的重點耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, sorry. White pearls are fresh right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈsɑɹi waɪt pɝlz ɑɹ fɹɛʃ ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，抱歉。白珍珠現在還有新鮮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tiny clear ones? Are they chewy too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪni klɪɹ wʌnz ɑɹ ðeɪ ˈtʃui tu/
dialogue.zh: 那種小小透明的嗎？也有嚼勁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, softer, and they soak up flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsɔftɚ ænd ðeɪ soʊk ʌp ˈfleɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，口感更軟，而且會吸收味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll try them, surprise me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ aɪl tɹaɪ ðɛm səpɹaɪz mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，我試試看，給我一個驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And grass jelly? We've got plenty of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɡɹæs ˈdʒɛli wiv ɡɑt ˈplɛnti əv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 要仙草嗎？仙草我們還有非常多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's grass jelly taste like, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ɡɹæs ˈdʒɛli teɪst laɪk ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，仙草是什麼味道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like aloe, but firmer and not too sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk əˈloʊ bət ˈfɝmɚ ænd nɑt tu swit/
dialogue.zh: 像蘆薈，但更扎實、也不會太甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, weird sell, but I'll take one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ wɪɹd sɛl bʌt aɪl teɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這形容真怪，但我來一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll love it. Hot or iced for the jelly?
dialogue.phonetic: /jul lʌv ɪt hɑt ɔɹ aɪst fɚ ðə ˈdʒɛli/
dialogue.zh: 你會愛上它。仙草要熱的還是冰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iced, everything iced in this weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪst ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ aɪst ɪn ðɪs ˈwɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 冰的，這種天氣什麼都要冰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same. So, large taro, thirty sugar, less ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm soʊ lɑɹdʒ təˈɹoʊ ˈθɜɾi ˈʃʊɡɚ lɛs aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。大杯芋頭、三分糖、少冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus white pearls and grass jelly. Perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs waɪt pɝlz ænd ɡɹæs ˈdʒɛli ˈpɝfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 再加白珍珠和仙草，完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's two ninety total. Do you have a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts tu ˈnɪnti ˈtoʊɾəl du ju hæv ə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 總共兩塊九。你有會員卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card? Like a membership? Not yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd laɪk ə ˈmɛmbɚˌʃɪp nɑt jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 卡？會員卡那種嗎？還沒有耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can sign up right now, it's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən saɪn ʌp ɹaɪt naʊ ɪts fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 現在就能免費註冊一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I get if I join?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ ɡɛt ɪf aɪ dʒɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 加入會員有什麼好處？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One stamp per drink, ten stamps, one free drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn stæmp pɚ dɹɪŋk tɛn stæmps wʌn fɹi dɹɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 一杯蓋一個章，湊滿十個就送一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, stamps while you make it?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt stæmps waɪl ju meɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，做飲料的同時就蓋章嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, and members get a drink today at half off.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ænd ˈmɛmbɚz ɡɛt ə dɹɪŋk təˈdeɪ æt hæf ˈɔf/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且會員今天這杯直接半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half off? Okay, sign me up, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ˈɔf oʊkeɪ saɪn mi ʌp hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 半價？好，幫我加入，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just need a phone number, um, or an email.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dʒʌst nid ə foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ ʌm ɔɹ ən ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 只需要一個手機號碼，嗯，或是信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email works: bobaqueen at mail dot com.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl wɝks ˈboʊbəˈkwin æt meɪl ˈdɑt kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 信箱也行：bobaqueen，加 mail 點 com。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bobaqueen, nice username, you're official now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈboʊbəˈkwin naɪs ˈjuzɚˌneɪm jʊɹ əˈfɪʃəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: bobaqueen，很棒的帳號名，你是正式會員了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, thank you. Oh, is that machine spraying?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ θæŋk ju oʊ ɪz ðæt məˈʃin ˈspeɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，謝謝。噢，那台機器在噴水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sealer's acting up, hold on, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsilɚz ˈæktɪŋ ʌp hoʊld ɑn wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 封杯機在鬧脾氣，等我一下，馬上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It got a little milk tea on my sleeve!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɑt ə ˈlɪɾə milk ˈti ɑn maɪ sliv/
dialogue.zh: 我的袖子沾到一點奶茶了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry, here, napkins and a wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi hɪɹ ˈnæpkɪnz ænd ə waɪp/
dialogue.zh: 真的很抱歉，給，紙巾和濕紙巾都來一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine, it happens, no big deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn ɪt ˈhæpənz noʊ bɪɡ dil/
dialogue.zh: 沒事啦，偶爾會這樣，小事一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me redo the seal properly, thirty seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɹiˈdu ðə sil ˈpɹɑpɚli ˈθɜɾi ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 讓我好好地重新封一次杯，三十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, can I look at the menu board?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ kən aɪ lʊk æt ðə ˈmɛnju bɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 好呀，我可以看一下菜單板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, and your jelly's already in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd jɔɹ ˈdʒɛliz ɑlˈrɛdi ɪn ðə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 請隨意，而且你的仙草已經進杯子囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. So, how do I drink the tiny pearls?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ haʊ du aɪ dɹɪŋk ðə ˈtaɪni pɝlz/
dialogue.zh: 好。請問這種小珍珠要怎麼吸上來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big straw, tilt the cup, gravity does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ stɹɔ til ðə kʌp ˈɡɹævəti dʌz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用粗吸管、把杯子傾斜，重力幫你搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip. Do you have the pointy straws?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp du ju hæv ðə ˈpɔɪnti stɹɔz/
dialogue.zh: 好撇步。你們有尖頭吸管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sealed ones? Sure, here, take two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sil wʌnz ʃʊɹ hɪɹ teɪk tu/
dialogue.zh: 獨立包裝的那種嗎？當然，拿去兩支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One for me, one for my brother, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɚ mi wʌn fɚ maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 一支我的，一支給弟弟，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, enjoy your boba experiment!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ ˈboʊbə ɪkˈspɛɹəmənt/
dialogue.zh: 全部好了，享受你的珍珠茶實驗吧！

script.youtube_title: 【手搖飲店🧋】「幫我加入會員」一杯芋頭奶茶的完整客製點單🥤✨🎧｜聽完就會自己選冰和糖｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Customizing a Boba Tea Order
script.youtube_title_en: "Sign Me Up" — Customizing a Boba Tea With Sugar Levels and Toppings
script.youtube_description:
「半價？好，幫我加入！」在手搖飲店，除了選飲料，還要選甜度、冰塊和配料，你來得及把所有選擇講清楚嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在熱門的手搖飲櫃台。

你會聽到：怎麼說甜度與冰塊（thirty percent、less ice）；珍珠賣光了怎麼換成白珍珠和仙草；註冊會員、蓋集點章、拿到半價的完整對話；還有封杯機噴水這種小意外怎麼用英文輕輕帶過。

整段對話都是 A2 初級短句，配上美國店員常用的自然語感：um、yep、hold on、same energy。聽完你就會用：Can I get extra?、What sugar level do you want?、Sign me up、No big deal。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，下一杯珍珠奶茶就用英文點。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Half off? Okay, sign me up!" At a boba shop you order more than a drink: sugar level, ice, toppings, and maybe a membership. Can you say all of it in English? This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at a busy boba counter.

You will hear: choosing sweetness and ice (thirty percent, less ice); swapping sold-out pearls for white pearls and grass jelly; signing up for stamps and a half-off drink; and brushing off a leaky sealer machine with easy American small talk.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences, full of natural fillers like um, yep, hold on. By the end you'll own phrases like Can I get extra?, What sugar level do you want?, and Sign me up.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so open your mouth and order your next cup in English.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
走進手搖飲店，店員問你甜度、冰塊和配料，你能在十秒內全部講清楚嗎？招牌珍珠剛好賣光，還有別的辦法嗎？

這一集帶大家走進一家人氣手搖飲店，從開口的第一句、客製化選糖選冰，到換配料、辦會員、封杯機噴水的小插曲，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧋 選甜度冰塊：Less ice, please. My bag never stays dry.
🤔 換配料：Wait, the famous pearls are gone?
🎁 辦會員：Half off? Okay, sign me up, ha.
😅 小意外：It got a little milk tea on my sleeve!

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 yep、ugh、hold on 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這一杯芋頭奶茶走一趟，下次站到櫃台前，選擇題就變成送分題。

祝你下一杯，甜度剛剛好。
